name: Reminder scheduling dispatch and delivery log
description: Verify reminder scheduling, duplicate prevention, Telegram dispatch result, and delivery history.

planSteps.description: The page shows pending, sent, failed, and skipped delivery counts plus scheduling and dispatch controls
Click Bugünü planla once, wait for completion, then click it a second time
The second scheduling action does not create duplicate deliveries and the page remains functional
If pending deliveries exist, click Bekleyenleri gönder
Each attempted delivery is recorded as sent or failed with an honest status; no fake success or page crash occurs
The delivery log lists schedule date, entity, message or status, and error details for failures
